\section{\texttt{resolve\_api\_principal}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.auth.resolve_api_principal}\index{Functions!resolve\_api\_principal}

Resolve an optional API key into a principal.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
resolve_api_principal(api_key: str | None, *, auth_enabled: bool, reader_key: str | None, writer_key: str | None, admin_key: str | None, tenant_bindings: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> ApiPrincipal
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{api\_\allowbreak{}key}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, required.
  \item[\texttt{auth\_\allowbreak{}enabled}] \texttt{bool}, required, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{reader\_\allowbreak{}key}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, required, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{writer\_\allowbreak{}key}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, required, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{admin\_\allowbreak{}key}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, required, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{tenant\_\allowbreak{}bindings}] \texttt{Mapping[str,\allowbreak{} str]\allowbreak{} \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{ApiPrincipal}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{ApiAuthConfigurationError}, \texttt{ApiAuthenticationError}
\apifield{Details}When auth is disabled, local callers receive an unauthenticated admin principal so route-level dependencies become no-ops. Authenticated identities are derived from the normalized API key; key rotation changes identity, while changing its role preserves identity.
